# Trick-Ninza

> A friendly static math-practice site for learning addition and subtraction mental-math tricks through interactive practice.

## About

Trick-Ninza teaches addition and subtraction mental-math shortcuts with clear explanations, worked examples, trick-specific quizzes, and randomly generated interactive puzzles.

## Key Pages

- [Home](index.html) - Introduction to Trick-Ninza and a starting point for practice.
- [Addition](addition.html) - Addition mental-math tricks, examples, and interactive quizzes.
- [Subtraction](subtraction.html) - Subtraction mental-math tricks, examples, and interactive quizzes.
